title: Briefing the Institute of Noetic Sciences board

tellings.quote: Like I astronaut Ed Edgar Mitchell invited me to uh brief the board of knowetic sciences back years ago.

plain: Steven Greer, who campaigns for the government to release what it knows about UFOs, says the astronaut Edgar Mitchell once invited him to brief the board of the Institute of Noetic Sciences, a research institute Mitchell founded to study consciousness. Greer tells it as something he did himself, years ago, in the 1990s, as a sign that serious figures took his work seriously.
